name: reactemail
description: Load, edit and save email templates with the React Email 6 editor, as a Mendix pluggable widget.

author: João
comment_react_version: Both the toolchain major and React must match the target Studio Pro.
pluggable-widgets-tools 11.x is the Mendix 11 toolchain and expects
React 19; on React 18 it refuses to build and instead prompts to
'migrate' the dependencies, which in a non-interactive shell reads EOF
and exits 0 without building anything. 10.24.x is the Mendix 10.24
toolchain and expects React 18, which is what this app runs.
react and react-dom must NOT be listed as dependencies: the toolchain
marks both 'remove' and prompts to migrate if it finds them, which in a
non-interactive shell aborts the build. Pin them through resolutions
and overrides instead -- 10.24.0 expects exactly 18.2.0 there.
React must match the version the Mendix client provides, exactly.
The client supplies react and react-dom to the widget at runtime, but
react-dom/server is not on that externals list, so React Email's HTML
renderer is bundled into the widget. A bundled react-dom/server reads
internals off the host's react-dom, and those internals are renamed
between majors. React 19 here on a React 18 client fails at page load
with: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'd') -- that is
react-dom/server@19 asking React 18 for
__DOM_INTERNALS_DO_NOT_USE_OR_WARN_USERS_THEY_CANNOT_UPGRADE.
Mendix 10.24 ships React 18.2.0; Mendix 11 ships React 19. The whole
React Email stack peer-accepts ^18 || ^19, so pin to whichever the
target Studio Pro uses and rebuild when the app is upgraded.
comment_rollup_version: pluggable-widgets-tools 10.24.0 builds with rollup 3 and ships its own
copy, but every @rollup/plugin-* it depends on peer-requires rollup 4.
npm installs those peers, hoists rollup 4 to the top, and gives it the
node_modules/.bin/rollup link -- so the v3-shaped config is handed to
the v4 binary and the build dies with 'Unknown input options: acorn,
maxParallelFileReads, preserveModules'. Pin rollup so the hoisted copy
and the bin link are the version the config was written for.
